title: Finite-dimensional top coherent cohomology of separated finite-type schemes over a field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The statement does not assume properness, so standard proper cohomology finiteness cannot be applied directly. The proof combines induction on dimension and coherent devissage with Chow modification, relative ampleness and a lower-dimensional cokernel, then obtains a surjection from cohomology on a projective compactification.
